1.name: Swing
1.desc: Allows multiple attacks in one round. Proficiency in this skill along with the weight of the weapon influences how many times a character can attack/round. What this skill actually does is decrease the "freeze time" after a weapon is used, and also to decrease the amount of time between each attack.

2.name: Accuracy
2.desc: Increases the chance to connect hits and also disrupts the enemy's evade skill.

3.name: Damage
3.desc: Increases the amount of damage dealt when attacking with one's weapon.

4.name: Sharpshoot
4.desc: Increases the range of long range weaponry as well as the critial rate. The critical rate increase is added onto whatever bonus gained from the character's Critical skill.

5.name: Counter Attack
5.desc: Increases the chance of counter attacks. Also adds to the chance of counter attacks after successful execution of Shield Defense and Parry skills.

6.name: Heavy Damage
6.desc: Increases the chance of critial hits (Double Damage). Once above Skill rank B+, characters gain a chance for triple damage.

7.name: Continual Attack
7.desc: While the Swing Skill increases the speed of attack, this skill increases the number of separate actions a character can do per round. Thus, a character can attack separate enemies in one round, or perform two separate attack sequence against one enemy.

8.name: Freeze
8.desc: Allows character to inflict the Stun status on enemies (stops all movement for few rounds) when attacking with weapons. Once progressed beyond Rank B, the character also acquired the chance to paralyze the enemy (stops movement for entire combat).

9.name: Thief
9.desc: Allows character to steal money from enemies when an attack connects. Proficiency in this skill increases both the chance of the actual theft occuring as well as the amount of potch stolen.

10.name: Repel
10.desc: Increases the chance a character evades enemy physical attacks.

11.name: Parry
11.desc: When evade fails, the character attempts to deflect physical attacks with their weapon. Also increases the chance of counter attacks.

12.name: Shield Protect
12.desc: Increases the chance attacks are deflected by a character's shield. Also increases the chance of counter attacks beyond skill rank C.

13.name: Armor Protect
13.desc: Increases the defense value of the armor worn by the character. Also increaes the chance of "Critical Guard," where physical attacks are completely nullified.

26.name: Holy Dash
26.desc: Allows a character to move longer distances/round in combat. This allows characters to attack even after moving long distances.

39.name: Adrenaline Power
39.desc: Allows characters to regain a certain amount of HP after a character sustains enough damage to go under 0 HP. Proficiency in this skill increases the chance of the Death's Door actually being triggered as well as the amount of HP regained.

27.name: Fighting Spirit
27.desc: Resists Stun and Unbalance status when such statuses are inclicted by enemy physical/magic attacks or from unite attacks with allies.

14.name: Fire Magic
14.desc: Reduces the time used to cast fire element spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

15.name: Water Magic
15.desc: Reduces the time used to cast water element spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

16.name: Wind Magic
16.desc: Reduces the time used to cast wind element spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

17.name: Earth Magic
17.desc: Reduces the time used to cast earth element spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

18.name: Lightning Magic
18.desc: Reduces the time used to cast lightning element spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

19.name: Shield Magic
19.desc: Reduces the time used to cast shield rune spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

40.name: Pale Gate Magic
40.desc: Reduces the time used to cast pale gate rune spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

20.name: Blinking Magic
20.desc: Reduces the time used to cast blinking rune spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

41.name: Sword of Magic
41.desc: Reduces the time used to cast magic sword spells as well as the effectiveness of each spell.

21.name: Magic Repel
21.desc: Allows character to reflect and completely negate magic spells cast by enemies.

22.name: Magic Resistance
22.desc: Reduces the damage received from enemy magic spells.

23.name: Focus
23.desc: Reduces the cancellation rate of spells when a character is attacked while casting a spell.

24.name: Chanting Volume
24.desc: Reduces the cancellation rate of spells when attacked during a song. The effect of this skill is added onto the focus skill.

25.name: Chanting Purity
25.desc: Increases the effect of Minsterl Rune spells. This skill doesn't reduce the casting time like other magic skills.

42.name: Precision
42.desc: When casting area effect spells, this skill reduces the chance of such spells cuasing harm to allies.

43.name: Magic Rationing
43.desc: When magic is used, this skill increases the number of lower tier magic usable. For example, if a level 2 magic is used in combat, the character gains one level 1 magic slot (but not beyond established max).
